svg.aria-label: Two grids of attention weights. Self-attention in the encoder: every English token, as a query, looks at every English token. Cross-attention in the decoder: every Russian token looks at every English token; the cell where the query of ▁сказала meets the key of ▁she is highlighted
svg.title: Two grids of attention weights. Self-attention in the encoder: every English token, as a query, looks at every English token. Cross-attention in the decoder: every Russian token looks at every English token; the cell where the query of ▁сказала meets the key of ▁she is highlighted
svg.text: Each row is one query and the weights it will give to every key, the columns. The solid cell
is one query meeting one key: she and the first piece of researcher; сказала and she.
